nina: Opening coordination for migration `mig_2026_06_userflags_safemode`. Window 02:50-04:20 PST. Adds nullable user_flags jsonb and a tiered backfill with safemode escapes. Canary hold at 03:18.

deploybot: queued migration mig_202606 (id: mig-202606). Canary holdpoint scheduled 03:18. Controls: `/deploy abort 1714512345`, `/deploy continue 1714512345`, `/deploy update 1714512345 --param=value`.

omar: TL;DR: avoid previous tail spikes. New tactics: progress markers, resumable checkpoints, and safemode that switches to COPY-only for flagged tenants if deadlocks > X.

lucy: Runbook snippet (add to bundle):

```sql
-- migration: add column
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN user_flags jsonb NULL;

-- resumable batched update loop (psql-style)
DO $$
DECLARE last_id BIGINT := COALESCE((SELECT last_id FROM backfill_progress WHERE name='mig_202606'), 0);
BEGIN
  LOOP
    WITH batch AS (
      SELECT id FROM users WHERE user_flags IS NULL AND id > last_id ORDER BY id LIMIT 3000
    )
    UPDATE users u SET user_flags = '{"flags":[]}' FROM batch b WHERE u.id = b.id RETURNING u.id INTO last_id;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      EXIT;
    END IF;
    PERFORM pg_sleep(0.12 + random() * 0.12);
    -- persist checkpoint
    INSERT INTO backfill_progress(name, last_id) VALUES('mig_202606', last_id)
      ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET last_id = EXCLUDED.last_id;
  END LOOP;
END$$;
```

lucy: COPY strategy note: for tenants >3.5M rows use streaming COPY with temp file to avoid heavy WAL churn. Mark them in `tenant_backfill_policy` table.

oncall: Added ops endpoints: `POST /ops/backfill/ratecap` and `POST /ops/backfill/safemode` (toggles COPY-only for problematic tenants). Tokens shared to oncall-private.

omar: Proposed deploy params: batch_size=3000, jitter_pct=12, concurrency=4, sleep_ms=120, safemode_enabled=true, resume_check=true. Canary 03:18.

deploybot: params applied for 1714512345: batch_size=3000, jitter_pct=12, concurrency=4, sleep_ms=120, safemode_enabled=enabled, resume_check=enabled. Start 02:50, canary 03:18.

nina: Rollback/abort triggers (consensus):
- p95 API latency +7% sustained 12m
- error rate +2% abs for 5m
- deadlocks >= 4 in 10m
- replication lag > 35s for 6m
- >3 tenant COPY failures in a row
If triggered: `/deploy abort 1714512345`, then run revert-prep: stop workers, snapshot backfill_progress, set `migration_state='aborted'` in metadata table, notify app teams. Dev lead for revert: omar.

lucy: Soft-verify plan: after canary we'll sample 1500 rows across 3 shards and validate default payload + schema. Script `tools/verify_backfill_sample.sh --n=1500 --shards=3` will output PASS/FAIL to this thread. If FAIL -> abort.

oncall: Canary holdpoint reached 03:18. Awaiting verification report.

lucy: Running soft-verify... `./tools/verify_backfill_sample.sh --n=1500 --shards=3` (running from canary host). Posting result in ~90s.

(late) tools: verify_backfill_sample.sh output: 1500 samples, 0 mismatches, schema ok. No p95 regression observed in 5m window.

nina: `/deploy continue 1714512345` — proceeding with gradual ramp: concurrency 4 -> 9 over 12 minutes.

omar: Monitoring pinned dashboards: backfill worker lag, p95, replica_lag, deadlocks. Added alert: auto-toggle safemode if deadlocks >=2 within 5m for a tenant.

~03:35 omar: Alert fired: tenant 8423 experienced 2 deadlocks in 3m while running UPDATE pattern. Auto-safemode toggled for that tenant (switching to COPY-only). Paused batches for 30s to allow recovery.

lucy: After safemode toggle, replication lag improved and deadlocks cleared. Resumed backfill for remaining tenants with safemode for tenant 8423.

oncall: At 03:46 replication lag spiked to 48s for 4m. Triggering operator action: posting `/ops/backfill/ratecap` with rps=8 which throttled workers. Not aborting yet.

nina: Decision: throttle + safemode for big tenants until lag <20s for 5m. If lag doesn't recover -> abort.

omar: Lag recovered to 12s after ratecap. Ramp resumed slowly; batch_size kept at 3000, concurrency lowered to 5.

lucy: Progress note: initial small-tenant wave done by 03:58 (~6% of rows). Large-tenant COPY jobs running in background and marked in progress table. Estimated finish 04:10-04:25 depending on COPY throughput.

~04:10 nina: Final status: small/medium tenants complete; big-tenant COPYs finished by 04:23. No abort. Backfill progress recorded in `/var/backfill/mig_202606/progress.json`.

nina: Post-run actions: open retro ticket with owners (lucy for runbook improvements, omar for safemode tuning, tom for automating ratecap response). Upload perf diffs, attach checkpoint file, and publish release note snippet to #release-notes with rollback instructions and feature-flag schedule.

oncall: Saved emergency tokens to vault and revoked temporary ones.

deploybot: migration mig_202606 completed successfully at 1714512820.

nina: Thanks team — closing thread.
